track: Track B — modeled hypothetical liquidation-boundary breach (proxy only, never observed liquidation)
rationale: Track A observed-liquidation labels are TRACK_A_STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED (no free unauthenticated complete census; see fclr_tracks01_viability_decision_20261123T014600Z). Per RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 16, pivot to Track B modeled breach on best free mark-price + margin data.

data_sources.name: ironflow_bulk candles_1h
data_sources.use: mark_price := close for the modeled breach path; per on-disk inputs table AGENT_HANDOFF.md

data_sources.name: ironflow_bulk open_interest
data_sources.use: mark_price/oracle_price cross-check; open_interest for notional context

label_construct.description: For each coin and forecast origin t, take the observed mark-price path; compute a hypothetical liquidation boundary from a frozen leverage/maintenance-margin scenario; label breach=1 if the forward mark price crosses the boundary within the horizon. Long and short labels kept strictly separate. Does not reconstruct account-specific liquidation engines, cross/portfolio margin, or actual forced liquidations (RESEARCH_PROMPT.md sections 15, 95-97).
label_construct.boundary_rule: liquidation_boundary_price(entry_price, leverage, side, maintenance_margin_rate); long: entry*(1 - 1/leverage + mmr); short: entry*(1 + 1/leverage - mmr)
label_construct.crossed_rule: boundary_crossed_future(mark_closes, t_index, boundary, side, horizon); uses only prices strictly after t_index (t+1..t+horizon); no leakage

features.rv_definition: trailing realized volatility from hourly mark-price log returns; RV6/RV24/RV168 log-scaled, lagged-vol persistence
features.funding_feature: signed funding rate (latest observation available by t, retaining sign separately)
features.abs_funding_percentile: train-only rolling percentile of absolute funding; require >= 30 valid historical funding observations before emitting
features.premium_feature: mark price / index price - 1, only when valid contemporaneous alignment under frozen tolerance
features.ma_deviation: mark price / 24-hour exponential moving average - 1, EMA from prior/current fully closed bars only
features.normalization: train-only means and standard deviations; no full-sample quantiles

model.fitting: stdlib Newton/IRLS; linear-probability fallback if separation is severe
model.constraint: simple constrained model; no unconstrained ML

metrics.contrast: out-of-sample loss relative to RV-only baseline (B1) with block-aware per-coin block bootstrap CIs

materiality_floor.metric: relative Brier improvement vs RV-only baseline

input_hash_assertions.note: SHA-256 sidecars asserted for every parquet read; caches not mutated; no network for heavy evaluation
